buildCommand: cd app/frontend && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npx expo export -p web
ignoreCommand: if [ -z "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ]; then exit 1; fi; git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || git fetch --quiet --depth=1 origin "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" || exit 1; git diff --quiet "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD -- app/frontend vercel.json
